conviction_note: No options and no reaction history, so the scale is 82.9% realised vol on a ~$150k/day ADS plus the one comparable event (H1 print 2026-08-18: +12% early, $5.60-$10.10 range, closed -4.5%), giving abs_move 11; p_up 45 leans slightly down because the only new company-level facts since the last print are financing-shaped (going-concern flag, a Dec 22 EGM seeking board authority to issue shares/warrants/converts 'for future capital raisings', 120M ADS registered for resale) while the operating bar (H2 revenue $39-42M CC, exit-Dec run-rate $85-95M) looks reachable on Tesla's confirmation that Semi volume production and deliveries started in Q3; findings sum -1.4 against a scaled -1.1, consistent in sign and size.
bar: Company guide only (no consensus exists for a business update; one analyst, Canaccord Buy $8, initiated 2026-09-15). H1 release 2026-08-18: H2 2026 constant-currency revenue growth 60-73% YoY (https://www.taiwannews.com.tw/en/news/6423648). H1 call (automated transcript, https://www.webull.com/news/15424006487491584): H2 revenue $39-42M CC, H2 adjusted EBITDA -$35M to -$37M, H2 contribution margin 21-23%, exit December 2026 at an annualised revenue run-rate of $85-95M; 'For Q3 ... a business update and select key figures', full quarterly reporting from 2027. Arithmetic: FY2025 revenue SEK 457.8M less H1 2025 SEK 216.5M = H2 2025 SEK 241.3M, so the guide implies H2 2026 of roughly SEK 386-417M against H1 2026 SEK 263.5M, i.e. a sharp Q3/Q4 step-up from the Amazon ramp and first Tesla Semis. Bar is a company guide, so findings are not capped for an unsourced bar, but the transcript is machine-generated.
positioning_check: Short interest 334.5K shares, ~0.2% of float, 3.7 days to cover, up 11.9% period-on-period (StockTitan, page read 2026-11-17, https://www.stocktitan.net/overview/ENRD/); MarketBeat: 298,924 shares at 2026-10-15 settlement, +82.1% from 164,115 on 2026-09-30, 2.1 days to cover (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/options-einride-nasdaq-enrd-stock-short-interest-climbs-821-2026-11-01/). Curved Trading lists a borrow fee of 80.8% (date not shown, https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/enrd/), so shorting is expensive but the short is not crowded; no squeeze mechanism of size. No listed options (baseline status no_options_market), so no skew. Tape: spot $2.08, -86% from 52w high, +16.9% off the 52w low, 5d +5.05%, 20d -16.8%; ADS closed $2.18 on 2026-11-12, $1.95 on 2026-11-16 (after the EGM notice filed 2026-11-13 16:05 ET), +6.7% to $2.08 on 2026-11-17. 120,278,913 ADS registered for resale against ~146.7M shares outstanding.

findings.finding: Einride called an EGM for 2026-12-22 (6-K filed 2026-11-13 after the close) to quadruple-range its share limits to 146.9M-587.6M and to give the board authority until the next AGM to issue shares, warrants and convertibles with or without preemptive rights, stated purpose 'flexibility for future capital raisings'; set against June 30 cash of SEK 748M ($77M), H1 operating cash outflow SEK 537M (incl. SEK 203M one-off advisory fees), a guided H2 adjusted EBITDA of -$35M to -$37M and a going-concern doubt repeated in the 2026-09-28 prospectus, the Q3 'select key figures' will likely show Q3-end cash near $55-60M and the call will be asked about the raise, which the market sees inside the window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No earnings-reaction history in the baseline. On the H1 print (2026-08-18) the stock opened about +12% on the Tesla deal and H2 guide and closed about -4.5% (range $5.60-$10.10) with coverage citing cash burn and financing dependence (https://business-news-today.com/einride-stock-reverses-despite-500-tesla-semi-deal-as-losses-overshadow-60-growth-outlook/). The July resale-registration filing coincided with a -13.8% intraday day. The EGM notice itself was followed by $2.18 -> $1.95 (-10.6%) over the next two sessions and a +6.7% rebound on 2026-11-17.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock fell ~10% after the notice and then recovered a third of that on 2026-11-17, so the market has seen the authorization but not a cash number, a size or a timing. What money buys: fleet growth is asset-financed (CFO: 100% asset-backed Tesla loans at ~14%), so an equity raise funds corporate burn under a going-concern flag, not a ramp; that is the negative answer to the financing question. If fully priced the stock would not have bounced into the print and the warrants would not still trade near $0.11-0.13.
findings.independence: Same concern seen in different documents: going-concern doubt in the 2026-09-28 424B3 (https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/ENRD/424b3-einride-ab-prospectus-filed-pursuant-to-rule-424-b-3-6a7bef463265.html); burn and cash from the H1 release (https://www.taiwannews.com.tw/en/news/6423648); the Norra Finans invoice-factoring limit raised SEK 550M -> 650M on 2026-09-30 (https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/ENRD/6-k-einride-ab-current-report-foreign-issuer-107dffaff28c.html), which is working-capital funding, not equity. Merged here rather than filed separately.

findings.finding: The H2 guide depends on the first Tesla Semis arriving (CEO: ~75 of the 500 in 2026, ~19 a month from September), and the counterparty has since confirmed the precondition: Tesla began customer Semi deliveries at its Sparks, Nevada plant in late September and said on its 2026-10-21 Q3 call it began Semi production in Q3 (25,000/yr installed capacity), so the business update is more likely to reiterate the H2 $39-42M / exit run-rate $85-95M guide than cut it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The only comparable is the H1 print, where a new 500-truck deal plus a guide for growth to more than double was bought +12% early and sold to -4.5% by the close: this name has sold good operating news on the day.
findings.why_not_priced: The stock is -86% from its high and -16.8% over 20 days, which is not what a market confident in a doubling of growth looks like; Tesla's production confirmation came on Tesla's call, not Einride's, and nobody covering Einride (one analyst) has updated the bar since. Still, no Einride-specific delivery count has been published, so the confirmation is of the supplier's capacity, not of Einride's receipts.
findings.independence: CEO plan of 75 Semis in 2026 (https://evwire.com/p/einride-75-tesla-semis-2026-rest-2027, 2026-08-27; https://www.teslarati.com/tesla-semi-biggest-adoptee-update-production-timeline/, 2026-08-28); Tesla volume-production report (https://www.freightwaves.com/?p=583828). No Einride document confirms trucks received; this is counterparty transmission, sized small.

findings.finding: Q3/Q4 operating milestones the update will recap are already public: Lidl cab-less truck on a German public road (2026-09-15), NVIDIA Hyperion collaboration (2026-09-21) and Alpamayo adoption (2026-10-21), two Level-4 driverless trucks in daily freight between EASE Logistics warehouses in Ohio as part of an $8.8M corridor project (2026-10-06/07), Lorenz autonomous fleet in Germany (2026-11-04), and the SEK 17M Ytterhälla transport acquisition (2026-09-04 prospectus).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None of these releases is visible as a re-rating in the tape: the stock went from about $3.15 to about $2.03 over the month in which most of them landed.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: each was press-released. What is not public is whether any of the autonomous deployments carry revenue that moves the H2 figure, which the update's select figures may show.
findings.independence: Headline list on https://www.stocktitan.net/overview/ENRD/ (read 2026-11-17); Lorenz release https://www.generation-nt.com/communiques-presse/einride-and-lorenz-bring-autonomous-fleet-to-production-facility-in-2084009.

findings.finding: 120,278,913 ADS (about 82% of the ~146.7M shares outstanding) are registered for resale under the F-1 effective 2026-09-28, re-supplemented on 2026-11-13 with the ADS at $2.18 and the warrants at $0.1149; on a ~71K-ADS-a-day tape, any pop on the business update meets registered selling holders.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The July resale registration filing coincided with a -13.8% intraday move; the H1 print's intraday +12% faded to -4.5% (both above).
findings.why_not_priced: The overhang is known and is part of why the stock is -86%; what is not priced is how it caps a reaction on a day with news. Short interest is only ~0.2% of float, so there is no short base to cover into a rally.
findings.independence: F-1 of 2026-09-11 (https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/ENRD/f-1-einride-ab-foreign-issuer-ipo-registration-12ac62af2c4f.html). Shares a document family with the financing finding but rests on a different fact (registered secondary supply, not new issuance).

findings.finding: The nearest listed autonomous-trucking peer, Aurora, reported Q3 on 2026-10-28 with revenue of $3.0M against a $3.23M consensus, softened its truck-count target to '20+ built and coming into the fleet', and kept selling stock through its ATM (~6M shares for $41M).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No measured link between AUR prints and ENRD moves; Einride's revenue is mostly electric freight-as-a-service, not driverless.
findings.why_not_priced: A peer's print three weeks old is in the price; it is filed only as a sector read on ramp slippage and dilution tolerance.

outside_window.finding: The EGM vote on 2026-12-22 on the new share limits and the board's authority to issue shares, warrants and convertibles without preemptive rights; an equity raise using that authority would most plausibly come after the vote.

baseline_tension: There is no option skew and no history to agree or disagree with; the findings lean mildly negative alongside a -16.8% 20-day run-up and a stock -86% from its high, so the financing negative is partly priced, which is why p_up sits at 45 rather than lower.
lessons_applied: Rule 4 (financing is a question) and rule 6 (keep inside the window): asked what the money buys (corporate burn under a going-concern flag, fleet already asset-financed, so negative), but moved the EGM vote and any raise under the new authority to outside_window and kept only the in-window part (Q3 cash figure and call commentary): -2.0 -> -1.5.
Rule 1 (a verified fact is not a predicted reaction): the H1 print sold good operating news from +12% to -4.5%, so the Tesla-confirmed guide-reiteration finding shrank +1.0 -> +0.7.
Rule 5 (proxy small, not left out): the Aurora peer finding stays filed at -0.2 as a proxy.
Rule 7 (look up short interest before a negative): SI ~0.2% of float, 2-4 days to cover, not crowded, so the negatives were not shrunk for squeeze risk; recorded in positioning_check.
abs_move_pct 11 and p_up 45 unchanged; rule 8 does not apply because no confirmed unpriced company-level number was found.
